title: Local model tool-call repair should recover malformed JSON before re-asking
body: Add a deterministic repair utility for malformed local-model tool calls and share it between Pipeline A and Pipeline B. It should recover common failures such as markdown fences, doubled braces, trailing commas, and unescaped Windows path backslashes before falling back to a re-ask.
interface: repairToolCallText repairs malformed JSON-like tool-call text and both local reply pipelines use it. The tests call: `node-bot/utils/repair-tool-call.js` (new) exports `repairJsonString(raw)` and `parseRepairedJson(raw)`.
why: Bad tool-call syntax is one of the self-work benchmark's recurring failure modes.
